msgs.t: Hardcopy. Lecturer says no report, no marks for the trip.
I only took photos and two pages of notes 😭

slides.b: First paragraph: the place, the date and what the trip was meant to show you.
Stop by stop, the way you walked it. Your notes and photos already follow that order.
Say what the photo shows and why it matters. Not just "Figure 1".
Name the topic from class that each stop showed in real life. That's where the marks are.
Three lines on what surprised you and one recommendation. Then stop.

Tell Toso where you went and paste your notes. Get the report laid out in Word or PDF.
Pay with M-Pesa. No card, no monthly bill.
